messages:
maria: Quick sync — we saw three spikes of cross-region LB retries yesterday (us-east-1 -> eu-west-1) around 02:10-02:25 UTC. Symptoms: increased 502/504s and intermittent TLS handshake failures. I pasted the timeline in the postmortem thread but wanted a focused remediation plan here.

kevin: Thx. I pulled a pcap from the affected window — clients get `TLSv1.3 Alert` then RST from the target. My initial hunch is route flapping + TCP conn resets during NLB failover.

dan: I can own the routing-side audit. Plan: validate regional routing tables + LB target registration during failover. Deliverable: list of 3 risky route policies and proposed fixes. ETA: EOD Thu (INC-4321).

zhao: I'll own the TLS/SNI side. Will verify certificate mapping and that SNI config isn't being rewritten by proxy. Also will confirm cert TTL monitoring (alert was noisy yesterday). ETA: Fri 10:00 UTC.

linda: I'll add a controlled canary/traffic-shift policy for cross-region fallback in the console so we can exercise the path without full blast. Also will add a dashboard tile for cross-region retry rate. ETA: Wed afternoon.

maria: Action items summary: 1) Routing audit — @dan (INC-4321) 2) TLS/SNI validation — @zhao (TKT-789) 3) Canary traffic policy + dashboard — @linda 4) Tune alerting for transient spikes — @kevin 5) Postmortem followups + runbook updates — @maria. Please add short notes to the incident board when you start.

kevin: I started a quick filtering query: ```json
{ "time_range": "2026-03-22T02:00:00Z/2026-03-22T02:30:00Z", "filters": ["lb:cross-region", "response:502,504", "tls:alert"] }
``` That shows correlation with route-update logs from the infra-controller at 02:11 UTC.

dan: Found one suspicious route policy: `route-policy-tilt-3` had an unexpected `weight:0` during failover window. Reproduced in staging by simulating partial AZ outage. Proposed fix: add guard to avoid zero-weighting in cross-region rollouts. Will PR by tomorrow.

zhao: TLS check: cert chain looks fine. But SNI map fallback exists when a target rejects SNI; we log at debug only. Proposal: elevate SNI mismatch logs to warn and add metric `sni_mismatch_count`. Opening TKT-790 to track.

maria: Good. One operational constraint — we must not add noisy alerts. For metrics that spike briefly during maintenance we should create ephemeral suppression window rather than delete the alert.

linda: Canary plan details: 10% traffic to eu-west for 30m, verify p50/p95 latency and retry_rate < 0.5%. If threshold exceeded auto-rollback to us-east. I'll add the policy and test in staging today.

kevin: I tuned the alert query to require sustained >1m spike before page: `avg_over_time(retry_rate, 1m) > 0.01`. Lower flappy noise.

sre-bot: Reminder: postmortem follow-up meeting scheduled Thu 15:00 UTC — calendar invite sent to participants.

maria: Let's check back Friday EOD with status updates. If any owner is blocked, ping here and we'll reassign. Thanks all :thumbsup:
